effect_description_eng:
While you have a Tamer, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] The next time one of your Digimon would digivolve this turn, you may trash 1 Digimon card in your hand of the same color as the digivolving Digimon to reduce the memory cost of the digivolution by 4.
